brief.grain: one row = one brief version, brief:<id>@<version>
brief.correlation: each handoff receiver carries metadata.correlationId = the id of the pair's first event, minted by that event's emitter
brief.impossible: every other gate × claim × outcome combination (26 of 36): the tables alone allow them, the handoff rules never produce them

refusal.grain: one row per transition refused while tira was unreachable; id = that transition's fx: key, so a reconciled refusal lands once

override.grain: one row per operator-invoked override (per incident), lasting at most 4 hours
override.derived: overdue: active past expires_at (needs now); late: expired after expires_at
